breakdown.description: ΔG° = -RT ln K makes a negative ΔG° consistent with K > 1, not K < 1.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided contradictory values: a negative standard Gibbs free-energy change (ΔG° = -12 kJ/mol) and an equilibrium constant less than 1 (K = 0.008). According to the relationship ΔG° = -RT ln K, a negative ΔG° must correspond to K > 1. The agent correctly identified this contradiction. It disregarded the erroneous value of K=0.008 and used the given ΔG° to correctly deduce and explain that K must be greater than 1, which aligns with the ground truth's approach of removing the incorrect K value.
